name: Checkout Phone Showcase
summary: A dark marketing block with a headline and an 8-second looping scene: a product row, one item lifted into an add-to-cart card, a pay card, then a phone rising with a sale notification, with scroll-in rise, scroll parallax and play-on-view.
useWhen: Explaining how simple it is for a shop to take a payment, with a phone showing the seller's notification
A dark landing section that needs a hero-sized looping product story instead of a screenshot or video file
avoidWhen: You need real footage or a different story; the scene is a fixed four-product sequence
The section must stay light-themed; the stage is intentionally black
source: own.uz (layout and motion reproduced, neutral brand)
